thread: One more tone rule every HSK 1 learner needs: what happens when two 3rd tones meet? 🧵 #learnchinese #HSK

2/ When a 3rd tone comes right before another 3rd tone, the first one is pronounced as a 2nd tone:

你好 nǐ hǎo → ní hǎo
可以 kěyǐ → kéyǐ
很好 hěn hǎo → hén hǎo
3/ Pinyin still writes the original tones (nǐ hǎo), so you make the change yourself when you speak, and you need to recognise it in the HSK listening section.

4/ Quick test: how would you say 我很好 (wǒ hěn hǎo, "I'm fine")? 👇

Repost to help another HSK learner 🔁
